control.$description: Padding inside controls, such as buttons, fields, options and tabs; changes with density.

stack.$description: Vertical gaps between stacked blocks, with condensed and spacious steps; changes with density.

prose.$description: Spacing in long-form text: paragraph gap, space around headings and list items; changes with density.

inline.$description: The gap between inline items, such as an icon and its label; changes with density.

chip.$description: Compact padding, such as inside chips and badges; changes with density.

field.$description: Gaps inside fields and fieldsets, such as between a label and its control; changes with density.

selection.$description: Checkbox, radio and switch size, and the gap to their label; changes with density.

overlay.$description: Padding and gap inside panels, such as dialogs, sheets, drawers, popovers and cards; changes with density.
